title: Pushed into Destiny by the One Who Knew Best
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner explores how Mary's unwavering faith and influence pushed Jesus into his destiny, and how mothers everywhere can do the same for their children. Join us as we discover the significance of Mary's role in Jesus' early life and learn how to speak life and purpose over our loved ones. This sermon will inspire and equip you to unleash your child's full potential and help them step into their God-given calling.
